title: Data Processing Module
summary: This module provides comprehensive tools for preparing diverse raw data inputs, including images, text, and audio, into formats suitable for machine learning models. It encompasses tokenization, feature extraction, normalization, and model-specific preprocessing steps.

nodes.label: Raw Input Data
nodes.title: Raw Input Data
nodes.description: Unprocessed data (images, text, audio) provided by users or external sources, serving as the initial input for the processing pipeline.

nodes.label: Image Preprocessing
nodes.title: Image Preprocessing Submodule
nodes.description: Handles resizing, normalization, format conversion, and other transformations for raw image data, preparing it for various vision and multimodal models.

nodes.label: Text & Audio Preprocessing
nodes.title: Text & Audio Preprocessing Submodule
nodes.description: Manages tokenization, number normalization, and multimodal data preparation for text and audio inputs, including OCR and speech-to-text functionalities.

nodes.label: Model-Ready Features
nodes.title: Model-Ready Features
nodes.description: Processed and formatted data (e.g., token IDs, image tensors, audio features) ready to be consumed by various machine learning models for inference or training.

nodes.label: Machine Learning Models
nodes.title: Machine Learning Models
nodes.description: Various Transformer models that utilize the preprocessed data for tasks like generation, classification, object detection, or speech recognition.

edges.label: Processed image components (for multimodal)
edges.description: Image preprocessing outputs, such as image tensors or visual prompts, are used by multimodal processors within the text and audio module.

groups.label: Input Sources
groups.title: Raw Data Inputs
groups.description: Represents the initial, unprocessed data streams that enter the data processing pipeline.

groups.label: Core Processors
groups.title: Core Data Processing Submodules
groups.description: The main submodules responsible for transforming raw data into a model-consumable format, handling different modalities.

groups.label: Output & Consumers
groups.title: Processed Data Output and Consumers
groups.description: Represents the final, prepared data output from the module and the machine learning models that consume this data.
